journey.name: MOD-04: 消息编辑与快捷指令触发
journey.description: 验证用户在底部编辑栏输入常规文字与输入斜杠“/”触发快捷指令弹层，测试指令自动补全、原子发送以及输入框状态重置与流式响应触发。

actions.action: Click the message input field "输入消息或 / 命令..."
Type "Hello Agent, this is an automated test message." into the input field
Verify that the "发送" button is enabled
Verify that the message input field is cleared
Verify that the user message appears in the message timeline
Click the message input field again
Verify that the slash command menu is displayed with available commands
Click the "发送" button to execute command
Verify that the command request is dispatched
